notes.title: New Freelancers and Atlas Reactor Launch!
notes.content:
In celebration of the official launch of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402570/]Atlas Reactor[/url] (the non-VR game) on October 4th, we've updated the Atlas Reactor VR Character Viewer!  In addition to new skins for many existing characters, this update also contains the 5 new characters that have been released since the last update!

The new characters are:
[list]
[*][b]Dr. Finn[/b] The 'Eeler - Sturgeon General with a healing gun and energized eels.
[*][b]Celeste[/b] The Rogue - Crafty thief who uses two grappling hooks to steal power-ups and knock out enemies.
[*][b]Blackburn[/b] The Last Soldier - Super soldier with an arsenal of deadly weapons at his command.
[*][b]Orion[/b] The Empyrean - Atom manipulator with a suit specialized to control his power.
[*][b]Juno[/b] The Last Word - A twin cannon-wielding warrior who stands her ground no matter the odds.
[/list]
Give it a try, and let us know what you think!

notes.title: New Freelancer: Elle
notes.content:
The Atlas Reactor VR Character Viewer has been updated with our latest character, Elle, The Enforcer.

Elle is a brutal assassin who uses a custom plasma gun to make as big a mess as possible.

Elle is a firepower lancer with tons of AoE and zero remorse. She is very good at consistently dealing damage with the variable range and spread of her plasma gun. Her Combat Reflexes allow her to dodge and attack with her plasma gun in the same turn. If Elle does find herself without good targets, her Overcharge allows her to add bonus damage to her next plasma gun attack so that she can make up the damage next turn. To complement Overcharge’s ambushing capability, Lurker Drone is an invisible trap that you can detonate just when you need it most.
